fluxqueue.reason: FluxQueue 0.3.2's official decorated task API is fire-and-forget and returns no job/result handle. Adding an external completion side effect would change the matched checksum-verifying completion semantics.

taskito.reason: Taskito 0.21.0 has a usable JobResult API, but it is a Beta SQLite-backed queue with materially different storage semantics. Adding and validating a new methodology now would expand this established Redis broker track.
